in_marathi.name: Gatha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Song, melody, verse
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gatha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, ‘Gatha’ translates to ‘song’, ‘melody’, or ‘verse’. It is derived from the root ‘Gam’ meaning ‘to go’, suggesting a journey through sound and wisdom.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Gatha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Sanskrit, ‘Gatha’ translates to ‘song’, ‘melody’, or ‘verse’. It is derived from the root ‘Gam’ meaning ‘to go’, suggesting a journey through sound and wisdom.
